title: Mirror Wall / Fairy Box continuous battle-trap adapter

cards.name: Mirror Wall
cards.officialText: Halve the ATK of your opponent's attacking monsters. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 2000 LP or destroy this card.

cards.name: Fairy Box
cards.officialText: When your opponent's monster declares an attack: Toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, the attacking monster's ATK becomes 0 until the end of the Battle Phase. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 500 LP, or destroy this card.

behavior.mirrorWall: Enquanto face-up, cada cópia reduz pela metade (arredondamento para baixo) o ATK do monstro atacante da equipe adversária durante a batalha; cálculo não muta ATK base/boost do monstro.
behavior.fairyBox: Na janela de declaração de ataque, uma chamada e um resultado de moeda são fornecidos explicitamente. Se coincidem, o ATK do atacante é zero até o fim da Battle Phase identificada; uma nova fase não herda o zero.
behavior.upkeep: Cada UID de cópia tem manutenção independente por turno: Mirror Wall 2000 LP, Fairy Box 500 LP. Pagamento é debitado da equipe controladora; recusa ou LP insuficiente destrói a cópia e envia ao Cemitério do proprietário físico.
behavior.integration: Adapter isolado. Não altera resolver central, tagActions, comandos Discord, catálogo, metadata, certificações, allowlist, dados persistentes ou inventário.

invariantCoverage: TagDuel 2v2 physical UIDs conserved and unique
three shared Monster Zones + three Spell/Trap Zones per team
separate Field Zone and Extra Deck max 5
Mirror Wall affects only opponent attacking monster and does not mutate monster state
Fairy Box deterministic coin call, Battle Phase-scoped ATK zero, duplicate activation protection
Fairy Box attack window excludes Damage Step and same-turn Set
per-copy Standby Phase upkeep, idempotency by turn+UID
LP is charged to controller team and destroyed card goes to physical owner's Graveyard
no inventory grants or automatic certification

certification.reason: M577 is an isolated behavior adapter; central resolver, metadata, certification fingerprints and released-card allowlist were not changed.
